title: NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents
friendlyTitle: GenAI Agents is a large library of agent examples
summary: A popular collection of more than 50 notebooks and implementations covering generative-AI agent patterns, from conversational systems and RAG to multi-agent workflows and evaluation.
friendlySummary: This open-source project contains more than 50 lessons and working examples for building different kinds of AI agents.
whyItMatters: Use it as a practical learning library or as reference implementations when testing an agent technique. The repository’s breadth makes it useful for comparing patterns before committing to a framework.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to learn an agent technique or find a starting example before building your own version.
